messages:
maya: quick heads-up — PR open to clarify the latency vs cost matrix on the Console observability page. current table mixes p50/p95 (ms) with per-token cost numbers and it’s confusing. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :eyes:
jonathan: thanks — can you paste the specific rows you want changed? iirc we used p95 for latency and usd/1M tokens for cost. mixing percentiles in the same column was the problem, right?
lucy: yep, mixing percentile labels is the issue. also one snippet references `time_window` but the SDK accepts `window_ms` now after the last SDK bump — that breaks the sample. i can paste the small fix.
maya: exactly. propose splitting into two columns: latency (p95 ms) and cost (USD / 1M tokens). then add a small note about sequence length assumptions (512 tokens) so numbers are reproducible. i'll update the MD table in the PR.
devex-erin: i’ll own the sample snippet changes + run the quicklink check. can you add a screenshot or example request/response? i want to include an SDK example for node/python showing how to set `window_ms` and `batching: false`. also add a one-line migration note: "SDK param `time_window` renamed to `window_ms` in v1.4.0"
maya: thanks — added a TODO comment in the PR for screenshot + example. also pinned the variants we used for cost calc.
jonathan: small nit — call out whether caching/prefix cache was enabled when measuring latency, since that affects p95 significantly. maybe show both cold and warm p95.
lucy: good call. i can capture a warm/cold p95 from the dedicated cluster (done earlier today). warm p95 ~ 78 ms, cold p95 ~ 210 ms for 512 tokens on A100-reserved pool. i'll paste numbers in the PR.
devex-erin: snippet I'll add (node):
```
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: "rwd-1b",
  prompt: "Summarize...",
  window_ms: 2000, // migration from time_window
  batching: false,
});
```
please confirm comment text for the migration note.
maya: that snippet looks good. for the migration blurb: "Note: SDK param `time_window` was renamed to `window_ms` in v1.4.0 — update inline snippets to avoid runtime errors."
sre-bot: deploy-check: docs CI passed for PR 4321 — link: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/4321 (all linkcheck tests ok) :white_check_mark:
devex-erin: awesome, i'll update the PR with the snippet, the warm/cold p95 lines, and add a short QA checklist: 1) run linkcheck, 2) confirm snippet runs locally, 3) validate screenshot alt text. assigning to @maya for review, target merge by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
maya: perfect — thanks team. i'll review once updates are in and then schedule the canary site push. closing loop here.
